mapper.select: INSERT INTO article SET regDate = NOW(), updateDate = NOW(), memberId = #{memberId}, region = #{tripRegion}, title = #{title}, `body` = #{body};
INSERT INTO articleImage SET articleId = #{articleId}, fileName = #{fileName}, contentType = #{contentType}, `data` = #{data}

SELECT A.*, M.name AS extra__name, AI.data AS extra__thumbnailImg, AI.contentType AS extra__contentType FROM article AS A INNER JOIN `member` AS M ON A.memberId = M.id INNER JOIN articleImage AS AI ON A.id = AI.articleId WHERE 1
AND A.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND A.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND A.tripRegion LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND M.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY A.id
SELECT A.*, AI.data AS extra__thumbnailImg, AI.contentType AS extra__contentType FROM article AS A INNER JOIN articleImage AS AI ON A.id = AI.articleId GROUP BY A.id
